_doc: Defaults used ONLY by the 3D reconstruction when the plan does not specify a value. Every default use is recorded in the 3D metadata.

ground._doc: Floor coverage (topology/ground.py): parts of the building outline (closed over notches up to 2 x close_m) not covered by rooms, walls or columns get a ground slab and a validation warning. A piece counts only when at least min_structure_share of its edge runs along a live wall, room or column.

_doc_balcony: Balcony walls (classification 'railing'): a low solid parapet of balcony_parapet_height_m with glass above it up to railing_height_m.
_doc_stack_levels: Multi-storey permit sets: true = floors moved onto each other at their levels; false = every floor plan stays where it is drawn, side by side at ground level.

level_slabs._doc: Stacked storeys (topology/level_slabs.py, reconstruction3d/builder.py): every floor-plan level gets a base slab and a roof slab over its closed outline. A plan that does not close (its closed shape covers less than min_hull_share of the hull of its walls) gets the outline that connects the outer vertices of its walls (concave hull with hull_ratio; 1 = convex). Levels whose name matches no_roof_names keep their top open (attic / roof storeys: their roof shape is not a flat slab). The storeys of a building repeat: the part of a storey's outline further than max_overhang_m beyond every other storey is cut (the lowest storey is kept; null = no limit).

pitched_roof._doc: Attic / roof storeys (level name matches level_slabs.no_roof_names) get a pitched hip roof (reconstruction3d/roof.py). Outline: the roof plan of the drawing when it has one (areas hatched with a roof-tile pattern: hatch_patterns are matched in the hatch pattern and layer name), else the storey's walled part; never wider than the storey below plus overhang_m. The outline is then made regular (regularize, topology/roof_plan.py): notches narrower than dormer_max_width_m (dormers, label boxes, gaps of the hatch) are closed and those entered from the eave line at least dormer_min_depth_m deep are kept as dormers; holes smaller than fill_holes_below_m2 are filled (larger ones stay open: a court); an untiled pocket inside the roof's closure (abutment_closing_m) that holds enclosed rooms of the storey and is bordered by the roof on at least abutment_min_enclosure of its perimeter is a core rising through the roof: its rooms and the walls around them (abutment_wall_margin_m around the rooms when no walls were found) become part of the roof body (flat top, not tiled); sides within angle_tol_deg of the building's main directions are squared to them and jogs shorter than min_edge_m removed (a part changing by more than max_area_change is kept as drawn). Shape: the straight skeleton of the outline (every side carries a plane rising inwards at pitch_deg), starting knee_wall_m above the attic floor and rising at most to the storey height (max_height_m overrides; above it the roof is flat). The attic's walls, columns and glazing are trimmed under the slope (points less than outside_tolerance_m outside the roof count as on its edge); with walls_outside_roof 'parapet', the outside_roof_types elements standing outside the roof (terrace edges) are capped at railing_height_m ('keep' leaves them). dormers: gabled boxes on the eave line, gable roof at pitch_deg, left out when the main roof is less than min_rise_m above the eave at the dormer's tip. tile: the roof surface is laid in courses of tiles (course_m exposed length up the slope, each course standing thickness_m proud at its lower edge), coloured alternately with colors.
